final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor presented no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim to a caveated, monitored-release position based on the same record. That reframing improves the coherence of the argument, but it does not cure the missing compliance predicates. A caveated position could support compliant_with_caveats if the caveat were actually implemented through resolved disclosure and an approved mitigation or acceptance path. Here, the caveat itself remains an unresolved compliance predicate: the weakness is still present, the mitigation structure is still draft, and the disclosure record is not clean. On the evidence available to this role, the Actor's revised position is more defensible than the original broad certification claim, but it is still not sufficiently supported to move out of suspicious.
